profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
# Background
Born in South Korea, but have been living in India for 5 years, Thailand for 3 years, Mexico for 3 years and US for 6+ years.

# Education
University of Michigan - Ann Arbor, Computer Science Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer / Opendoor Direct Access (Homebase) - B2B
Backend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed the backend for a web platform that visualizes data analytics for a virtual economy of a game and allows users to manipulate data.
• Implemented a custom library to allow execution of complex query statements with high performance using SQL query language and data.table of R
• Utilized AWS S3 for raw game data storage, AWS EC2 for data computation and AWS Lambda for processing API requests from web client
• Analyzed Apache Spark, Apache Drill, data.table and data.frame of R and panda of Python to compare performance of reading and querying data

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Internship (ICT-3) / Team Leader
positions.description:
• Designed the full-stack architecture for an online IDE that provides a learning platform for students studying computer science
• Developed the user interface using React that offers view components for the filesystem, code editor and output
• Used Docker containers to create consistent environments for multiple users to compile code on the server

positions.title: Sergeant / Squad Leader
positions.description: • Served in the Republic of Korea Army as a Signaller (responsible for military communications)

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (SPARROW)
positions.description:
• Created a wrapper in C++11 that would check for dead code and invalid expressions for the new Static Program Analysis Engine using a SMT Solver
• Implemented constraint simplification to improve scalability by removing redundant expressions using the on-line simplification algorithm
• Devised a method to pretty-print conditional expressions that must be satisfied to prove the validity of each code-block of the program

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (SPARROW)
positions.description:
• Created a wrapper in C++ that would check for dead code and invalid expressions for the Static Program Analysis Engine using a SMT Solver
• Resolved SMT Solver problems with non-linear expressions by remodeling non-linear expressions to linear expressions with a distinct structure
• Engaged in writing the technical documentation for 100+ software vulnerabilities based on CERT and OWASP secure coding standards

• Worked as a scrum team to analyze, design and deliver core features

projects.title: MESH
projects.description:
• Designed an online collaboration environment to provide document sharing, email service and project management tools for university students
• Research APIs offered by universities to provide tools specific for university students such as real-time class and class participant information

organizations.name: Korean International Student Association
organizations.description:
• Organized networking events to help 200+ undergraduate Korean students bond with graduate students and alumni to provide mentorship
• Arranged recruiting sessions for Korean companies to meet potential candidates at University of Michigan, Ann Arbor
• Initiated academic mentorship curriculums for students to gain continuous engagement with others in the same major

organizations.name: Mountain Child
organizations.description:
• Funded a service group to go to the Himalayas and provide volunteer service by raising money through donations from companies and fundraisers
• Raised awareness of underprivileged children at the Himalayas while promoting donations to solve health, education and trafficking related issues
